name: Iraira Yoku Bou 2 -Kasumi Hen-
original_name: いらいら欲棒２ -かすみ編-
source:
A gameplay game where stages are cleared with mouse manipulations while avoiding touching the sides. Each stage clear reveals new scenes with beautiful warriors in sailor suits.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这是一款通过鼠标操作，在不碰到边缘的情况下通过各个关卡的游戏。每通关一个关卡，便会解锁身穿水手服的美丽女战士的新场景。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
